Portrait setting: A cramped, dim hideout bar, closed and empty. Behind the character, a dark polished wooden counter with a row of high stools runs along one side, backed by shelves of bottles; a wall-mounted monitor hangs in the corner, a few small tables sit in shadow and the windows are covered. Worn floorboards and a faint haze of dust in the lamplight. No other people. No readable signs or text.

Scenery only: the choice does not move the character, grant access or affiliation, or supply props. Respect the selected frame and keep exactly one foreground character.

Portrait lighting — Key: A low pendant lamp just in front of the character, warm amber, from above. Fill: The dim amber glow of the backlit bottle shelves on the counter side. Bounce: Soft light off the polished counter. Practical: A row of pendant lamps over the counter and the gray static glow of the corner monitor.
